## BondoMod 0.2.43

- Added an installable Custom Quick Chat plugin with keyboard and controller binding capture.
- Added a live preview to the Controller Overlay design editor.
- Updated the F2 overlay tabs, Rank Display controls, and Rank Changer plugin.
- Added Repair BondoMod in Settings to clean up BondoMod changes before verifying Rocket League files.
- Added separate Boost and Trail Color controls. Trail Color is in testing.
